decisions.reason: As a compliance-related tool close to the core hosting offer, with an early positive agency-oriented signal and clear fit to the firm's in-house development capabilities, it is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.
Because this platform builds directly on the firm's core knowledge base and is presented as a flagship direction, absorptive capacity and strategic commitment both strongly favor continued support.

This managed hosting plan is closely related to the firm's established capabilities and should be easy to refine through internal learning, although the weaker visible market evidence makes it somewhat more droppable than the flagship products.
